model.title: Recognizing Community Organizations for Veteran Engagement and Recovery Act
model.meta: Veterans' Affairs Committee · Rep. Mike Bost (R-IL)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Veterans Affairs Department to launch a three-year pilot program providing grants to nonprofit mental health providers so they can offer culturally tailored, evidence-based mental health services to veterans.
